I read Murray Leinster's *The Brain-Stealer**s* recently. It's about a bunch of fat, lazy aliens who use telepathy to take control of humans. All it wants is for humans to keep them in a warm soft place and bring them blood every day.

Meanwhile, I had been working on some sci-fi stories about consciousness, and then I read this book. And then I stumbled on a book by Spider Robinson called *Mindkiller* in the books for sale at my local library. I snagged it*.*

I read Murray Leinster's The Brain-Stealers recently. It's about a bunch of fat, lazy aliens who use telepathy to take control of humans. All it wants is for humans to keep them in a warm soft place and bring them blood every day.

Meanwhile, I had been working on some sci-fi stories about consciousness, and then I read this book. And then I stumbled on a book by Spider Robinson called Mindkiller in the books for sale at my local library. I snagged it.
